formulaPolicy.projectionFactor: mean of disposition points across six projection targets and seven semantic paths
formulaPolicy.note: These are deterministic architecture comparison scores, not user preference or production reliability evidence.

architectures.label: Current canonical
architectures.summary: 160 Item과 210 SourceRow를 first-class로 보존하면서 일정이 있는 112개만 VEVENT로 투영한다. It preserves the full canonical contract and keeps calendar output destination-specific.

dimensions.label: Source 의미·provenance
dimensions.formula: 20 × source retention factor. X-property로만 복구되고 외부 client 보존이 미검증이면 0.5를 적용한다.
dimensions.evidence: Factor is fixed by the v2 architecture contract and verified corpus evidence.

dimensions.label: Item별 독립 완료 상태
dimensions.formula: 15 × independently recoverable completion factor. VEVENT는 FlowMe manual completion을 소유하지 않는다.
dimensions.evidence: Factor is fixed by the v2 architecture contract and verified corpus evidence.

dimensions.label: 일정·비일정 포괄성
dimensions.formula: 10 × (scheduled natural coverage + undated natural coverage) / 160. 미검증 VTODO는 undated coverage에 0.5를 적용한다.
dimensions.evidence: 112 scheduled + 48 undated Items; VTODO external support is NOT_PROVEN.

dimensions.label: 최소 입력·수정 단순성
dimensions.formula: 8 × setup/source-value reuse factor. source 값을 다시 묻지 않고 0~2개 setup input으로 시작하는지를 본다.
dimensions.evidence: Factor is fixed by the v2 architecture contract and verified corpus evidence.

dimensions.label: Calendar client 호환 위험
dimensions.formula: 10 × client-risk factor. 실제 Google/Outlook/Apple round-trip이 없으므로 단순 VEVENT도 최대 0.7, VTODO+RELATED-TO+X-property 의존은 0.2다.
dimensions.evidence: Factor is fixed by the v2 architecture contract and verified corpus evidence.

dimensions.label: 권리·검토·개인 overlay 보존
dimensions.formula: 10 × canonical layer retention factor. user export에 내부 review를 넣지 않으면서 canonical sidecar 없이 보존 가능한지를 본다.
dimensions.evidence: Factor is fixed by the v2 architecture contract and verified corpus evidence.

dimensions.label: Projection 손실
dimensions.formula: 10 × projection-loss manifest 평균. retained=1, grouped=0.8, description=0.65, sidecar=0.75, unproven=0.35, unsupported=0.
dimensions.evidence: Manifest mean retention=0.8857 across 6 targets.

dimensions.label: 현재 runtime 이관 영향
dimensions.formula: 7 × migration factor. 현재 Item adapter 유지=1, 새 canonical entity=0.57, ICS-first 교체=0.14.
dimensions.evidence: Factor is fixed by the v2 architecture contract and verified corpus evidence.

dimensions.label: Backend DTO 복잡도
dimensions.formula: 5 × DTO simplicity factor. 기존 canonical 계약 재사용=1, context indirection=0.6, component/X-property/sidecar 동시 관리=0.2.
dimensions.evidence: Factor is fixed by the v2 architecture contract and verified corpus evidence.

dimensions.label: 외부 도구 이식성
dimensions.formula: 5 × destination-neutral portability factor. 외부 account round-trip 미실행으로 canonical projection도 최대 0.8이다.
dimensions.evidence: Factor is fixed by the v2 architecture contract and verified corpus evidence.

comparisonConclusion: Current canonical remains preferred. The 48 undated Items strengthen the need for destination-specific projections and make literal ICS-first more dependent on unproven VTODO/RELATED-TO/X-property behavior. Persisted SharedContext still fails the three-bundle adoption gate; use projection-time grouping instead.
